sources.title: GitHub - Humer-Shaik/Lunar_lander: The Gym Lunar Lander environment ...
sources.snippet: This repository contains implementations and experiments for teaching an agent to safely land a lunar module in OpenAI Gym's LunarLander-v2 environment using Deep Reinforcement Learning techniques built from scratch with PyTorch. The project explores and implements several value-based RL algorithms and model architectures, including: Deep Q-Network (DQN) Double DQN (DDQN) Dueling DQN Each ...
